segments.text: GOd ſpake once agayne vnto Ahaz, ſaying: require a token of the lord thy god, whether it be toward the depth beneath, or towarde the heighte aboue. Then ſayde Ahaz: I will require none, neyther will I tempte the lorde. And he ſayde: hearken to, ye of the houſe of Dauid, is it not ynoughe for you, that ye bee grieuous vnto men, but ye muſt grieue my god alſo? And therfore the Lorde ſhall geue you a token: Beholde, a virgin ſhall conceiue and beare a ſonne, and his mother ſhall call his name Emanuel. Butter and Hony ſhall he eate, that he may know to refuſe the euil and chooſe the good.
